radio_capture_limitation: The previously tested interface exposed Ethernet/IP packets without 802.11/radiotap fields. This limitation applies to the tested capture mode; retest other supported modes separately.
missing_value_warning: Numeric zero can mean measured zero or unavailable data. The six Wi-Fi availability flags do not cover every feature. Inspect the adapter field mapping before interpreting zeros.
window_duration_note: The export includes packet-relative windows and packet-free intervals before the first packet and after the last packet, bounded by the recorded capture start and stop timestamps. Boundary windows may be shorter than the configured window size. Empty windows indicate no packets were assigned to that interval; they do not prove that every packet was observable.
